reading_limit: parameter growth is compared ONLY on tensor names shared with the factory base, because the factory file stores weights while trained arms also persist runtime state; the two numbers must never be summed. The activation half is a FINAL-STATE SNAPSHOT of tensors whose names match the activation vocabulary, not a per-tick magnitude series, and call counts (shadow_forward/learn_hits) are consumption evidence that must not be substituted for it. Counter-like tensors (`usage`, `age`) are published in a SEPARATE `counters` bucket: they live under the same `predictive_context` name prefix and, measured on the 150k arms, they dominate the maximum at 149,998 - folding them into the activation snapshot would turn a step counter into an apparent activation magnitude.
